description.p: This is a community package of PhotonCAM, maintained independently and unaffiliated with Niko Pietinen. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

PhotonCAM is a laser cutting and engraving CAM. It opens LightBurn projects and SVG files, writes GRBL G-code and Ruida programs, and can talk to a controller over USB serial. An optional web remote can show the job on another device on the same network.

Sandbox: display, all devices (USB serial for the laser controller, the GPU, and cameras for alignment), the Documents folder, where the app keeps its material library and traffic log and where a project path keeps working, and ~/.config/laser_burn for its settings. Open and Save otherwise go through the file chooser. There is no network access by default. The package does not send a job to a machine by itself.
A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: A controller behind a Raspberry Pi running PhotonCAM Bridge, the web remote, and the iPad bridge: flatpak override --user --share=network io.github.pietini69.photoncam. The web remote and the iPad bridge listen on every network interface without authentication, and their update endpoint downloads and runs a script from upstream's default branch, so anyone on the same network can trigger it.
Open a project by path outside Documents: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home io.github.pietini69.photoncam
Undo all of these: flatpak override --user --reset io.github.pietini69.photoncam
